notes.title: 海缸内容更新啦！！！Update
notes.notes: [p]本次更新内容： [/p][p]1、新增2个海鱼包共48种  [/p][p]2、新增礁石3种，珊瑚24种  [/p][p]3、新增海沙6种  [/p][p]4、新增海缸壁纸20张 [/p][p]5、新增海鱼收集对应的成就2个  新增海缸玩法： 出售稀有及以上品质的7星淡水成鱼，获得新的货币-贝壳。贝壳可用于购买咸水鱼缸对应的新鱼苗和珊瑚等装饰。  [/p][p]This update content: [/p][p]1. Added 2 new marine fish packs with 48 species in total [/p][p]2. Added 3 new reefs and 24 new corals [/p][p]3. Added 6 new sea sands [/p][p]4. Added 20 marine tank wallpapers [/p][p]5. Added 2 achievements for marine fish collection  New marine tank gameplay: Sell 7-star freshwater adult fish of rare or higher quality to get a new currency - shells. Shells can be used to buy new fish fry and corals and other decorations for saltwater fish tanks.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460286/165594aefeea1d33459b74213f1d6d6ab851811f.jpg"][/img][/p]
